name: Pioneer DDJ-FLX4
author: Reboxed
description: 2-deck controller, from the manufacturer's MIDI mapping: 8 pad modes, CALL < > that halve / double a playing loop (like the DDJ-GRV6), SHIFT + CALL for MEMORY / DELETE, SHIFT + jog search. Every mapped control is handled; not yet tried on the hardware: report problems with the MIDI monitor (Preferences > MIDI).

mods.name: Stems on the pads + EQ part isolator
mods.description: PAD FX becomes STEMS: top row = mute / unmute the vocal, inst, bass and drums parts, bottom row = Beat FX on that part only (the 8 stem buttons of a DDJ-GRV6). SHIFT + CUE switches the deck's EQ knobs to the parts (HI vocal, MID inst + bass, LOW drums) and back. Pad effects stay on SHIFT + PAD FX; jump to the track start is no longer on SHIFT + CUE.
